name: Bow Couch and Chair
description: The Bow Couch & Chair set features a distinctive continuous wooden frame that curves around each piece, forming both the armrests and structural support in one fluid motion. This sweeping “bow” design gives the set its name.
highlights: Continuous curved wooden frame that doubles as armrest and structural support
Matching couch and chair for a coordinated seating arrangement
The sweeping "bow" silhouette gives the set its name and its visual signature
installation: Once the file is installed and inZOI is running, open Build Mode and switch to the Furniture catalog. Search for "Bow Couch" to find the piece, it is listed under that name in the build menu, not under "MOOSTYLES." If it does not show up, confirm the mod is enabled in your mod manager and that you are on the tracked game version listed above before reporting it as missing.
